title: Research: certify a two-burst schedule for the fixed eight-field escape circuit
body:
PR5673's normalized eight-field escape circuit uses eight rank-one, square-zero thin queries in three bursts. This contribution supplies a complete two-burst schedule (four queries per burst) with the same six full-call matrices, eight fields and exact polynomial endpoint. Two occupied gaps are optimal for those fixed full matrices, even when all 720 full-call orderings and arbitrary constant thin matrices are allowed.

The lower bound is a corollary of PR5673's aggregate-map theorem; this package corroborates it with 5,040 literal linear contradiction certificates, each using at most three equations. The distinct construction is the two-burst word and its explicit rank-one square-zero decomposition. The checker covers every polynomial coefficient, replays the source and changed word, checks complete order/gap coverage, and rejects six corruptions. No solver is needed for replay.

**Scope and cost:** normalized characteristic-two algebra only. The one-burst certificates hold over every characteristic-two field. No changed full matrices, stage-dependent connector entries, physical/native lift, compiler, outer admission or new kappa is claimed. This does not settle the seven-query search. The unchanged complete optimistic P104 bill has linear margin -336 and rejects every concave moment, so no bound improvement is asserted. Required native adapters and implementation costs remain unimplemented and cannot repair that favorable negative budget.

**Base:** `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Source: PR5673 at `c10f75f09e41803ae8efe478331a7509b7379b2f`; source Git blob `aae71c6ad294d6bc9ca5e2216a7785b9e6611afd`. The PR5599 tariff is pinned to the base. SHA256 pins are in `research/connector-single-burst/SOURCES.json`. Selected kappa remains 0.00310045.

**Reproduce:**

```sh
python3 -B research/connector-single-burst/verify.py
```

Expected `PASS_SINGLE_BURST_OBSTRUCTION`, 720 orders, 5,040 certificates, eight thin queries in two bursts, and all rejection controls passing. Python standard library only; standalone without Git/network. Deterministic regeneration is documented in the package README. Normal and optimized replay, certificate regeneration, a Git-free export replay and publication guards are checked in the handoff. This is not proof-assistant or independent human verification. Shared predecessor packages and `upstream/` are unchanged; no unrelated suite or selected-frontier replay is claimed.

**Coordination and credit:** complex-supplier track, OS assignment seed 26; three candidate tasks, overlap and stopping rule are in `CLAIM.md`. No pinned sprint issue was available, so the claim and result are local. Credit Ali Romman for PR5673 and PR5599, Cinna Davis and the PR5617/5631/5649 controller lineage, and the cumulative P104/native/helper/compiler contributors. PR5681's static rank construction is complementary; it is not an implementation dependency. No priority claim over the one-burst theorem is made.

Prepared for **theon199** with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance in analysis, code, tests and writing. No subagents. New work is Apache-2.0; copied source data retains attribution in NOTICE.
